incidents.summary: Savills failed to obtain summary dismissal of a sexual harassment lawsuit whose allegations a judge described as indicating serious discriminatory sexist behaviour if true.

sources.title: Savills loses bid to toss sexual harassment suit | Lawyerly
sources.quote: US real estate firm Savills has failed to summarily dismiss a lawsuit alleging sexual harassment, which a judge said if true “indicated a culture of discriminatory sexist behaviour of a serious kind”.

incidents.summary: A former St James Quarter director sued Savills Management Resources alleging dismissal after raising fire safety and fraud concerns, with a tribunal witness also alleging years of missing maintenance tracking.

sources.title: Edinburgh's St James Quarter worker alleges 'fraud and health and safety' issues | Edinburgh Live
sources.quote: John Watt, 38, from Dunbar, is suing Savills Management Resources for unfair dismissal and public interest disclosure at the Edinburgh Employment Tribunal.

sources.title: Edinburgh's St James Quarter worker alleges 'fraud and health and safety' issues | Edinburgh Live
sources.quote: Back in February, Mr Watt claimed: "My dismissal followed my raising of fire safety concerns, serious health and safety concerns, and some really serious fraud of hundreds of thousands of pounds".

sources.title: Edinburgh St James Quarter worker claims 'things weren't being maintained' | Edinburgh Live
sources.quote: She further alleged that for years there was no system to track and document maintenance issues.
